hero.title: Your signature smile, crafted in Antalya & Istanbul
hero.subtitle: Dental implants, veneers and smile design — with a free initial consultation and full support for international patients.

treatments.title: Treatments focused on your smile
treatments.lead: Every treatment starts with a free initial consultation, so you understand your options before you decide.
treatments.implants: A titanium post placed in the jawbone replaces the missing root and supports a new crown — a fixed solution for one or more missing teeth.
treatments.veneers: Thin, custom-made shells bonded to the front surface of the teeth to refine their shape, colour and proportions.
treatments.smileDesign: A planned approach to your smile as a whole — tooth shape, colour and balance with your face — before any treatment begins.

journey.title: From your first message to your treatment in Türkiye
journey.lead: A clear path for patients travelling from abroad, with coordination at every step.

steps.text: Send the form or message us on WhatsApp.

steps.title: Receive your treatment package
steps.text: Your package brings your treatment and travel arrangements together.

steps.title: Travel with coordination
steps.text: Your hotel and airport transfer are coordinated for you.

steps.title: Treatment in Antalya or Istanbul
steps.text: Your treatment takes place at JOKAR DENTAL in the city you choose.

items.q: Is the first consultation really free?
items.a: Yes. Your initial consultation is free of charge.

items.q: In which cities do you treat patients?
items.a: In Antalya and Istanbul. Dental implants, veneers and smile design are offered in both cities.

items.q: Do you help with the hotel and airport transfer?
items.a: Yes. We coordinate hotel accommodation and airport transfers for international patients.
Yes. An interpreter is available for international patients.
